source: Brit seems convinced that it is Claudius having me killed, because he finds my affection for Hamlet dangerous. It's believable, almost... but if Claudius wanted me dead, he's killed before, and wouldn't send another to do that work. Still, maybe there is something to find there.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: My efforts paid off. The spy, and my repeated killer, is Lady Brit. She's been in Norway's graces all along. I've got to find a way to expose her before she slits my throat again. Now I just have to stop her.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Lady Brit is apprehended, locked away in a cell by Bernardo. Does this mean I've successfully prevented my death? If I make it to Saturday night, I'll know I have.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: By turning Lady Brit in to Bernardo, I managed to stop her from killing me this loop. It seems my success might be permanent - I was surprised by a visit from Quince, who promised me Brit would never come after my life again. How he intends to accomplish this, I'm unsure, but for now—I wonder what else lies before me.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: My Father's Death

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Bernardo just delivered the news: Father is dead. Hamlet killed him after the play Friday night. I... am having trouble processing, believing that it's true. There is so much I would have done differently if I had known this was how it was going to end. I'll miss you, Father.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: ...And yet, that wasn't the end after all. I'm back at the beginning again, in a time where Father is alive. I've never been so happy to have him berate me. Maybe I have a chance to change his fate! I know that he was killed in Gertrude's rooms, and that Hamlet committed the deed. Seems as good a place to start as any.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I decided to try the obvious and tell my father what I had seen. He found my warnings hard to believe, yet he seemed to take them into account anyway. Perhaps that will be enough to save him.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Though my father found my warnings disturbing, it doesn't seem telling him alone was enough to save him. Bernardo just informed me of his death - again. I need to know more about how the events played out - and find a way to change the state of that room.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: If I can find a way to access Gertrude's private chambers, maybe I can know more about the events that led to my Father's death.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I... I did it. I actually saved him. Though it did not come without a cost, it meant so much to me to see him live beyond a fate that previously seemed inescapable. I know it's a temporary victory - at the end of these days it will all be reset, and then he will probably die many times, just as before. But now... at least I know something can be done.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Prince Hamlet's Madness

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet showed up in my room, raving incomprehensibly. He's been difficult before, but this is strange even for him. What could be causing him to act out like this?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I've been pointed towards the gallery—perhaps something exists there that could give me some clue as to the origin of Hamlet's recent bout of madness.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: In the gallery, I found a clue as to Hamlet's madness. Apparently, he's been obsessing over some irregularities in his father's death report. Clearly, Hamlet suspects there is more to this story—but what is he hoping to accomplish?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: It seems that Hamlet is concentrating most of his energy on putting on a play for this Saturday. Something's brewing. I feel uneasy about this.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet's actions and plans seem to have borne fruit—after the play, King Claudius confessed to God that he was the snake who killed Hamlet's father. The revelation was stunning, but Hamlet was strangely unsurprised... his actions indicate he already knew? Where could he have gotten his information?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet's madness was brought on not by love, but by a meeting with what he believes to be the spirit of his father. It's from there he must have gotten his information about Claudius's murder. But the information turned out to be correct - so does this spirit actually exist?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The Barkeep and Me

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello, the barkeep in town, seems to live in a world separate from mine. I'd like to observe what his day-to-day life might be like.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The inn in town has been the target of a group of thugs lately, who are trying to extort Othello for more and more money. The situation is untenable for Othello. If the Royal Guard were aware, they might be able to protect him.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello has invited me to hear him tell stories... in private, after the bar is closed. I hardly think it's an innocent request, but I also find him respectful enough to feel safe seeing him alone. Father would be furious to know I'd gone without a chaperone, but... well, what he doesn't know can't hurt him, surely.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello told me the most incredible tale, and when he was done, he asked me about Hamlet. I didn't know what to say. Not exactly. But then... we kissed, and it was incredible. It still gives me shivers to think about it. What does this mean for my relationship to him? More importantly, ought I to go and see him again tomorrow, as he requested?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello told me the most incredible tale, and when he was done, he asked me about Hamlet. I didn't know what to say. Not exactly. He asked me if he could kiss me, and I turned him away. I don't think I can think of him that way, at least not right now.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello and I were together for the first time, in the woods. It was nothing like it was with Hamlet... he was gentle, but knew exactly what he was doing. It was the kind of quiet, intimate night I've rarely shared with another person, let alone someone unrelated to me. One of those nights when you feel as if you've known someone forever after just a few hours. Something large has shifted in our relation to one another. We were interrupted by Claudius. I've never been angrier in my life. How dare he try to tell me what's appropriate for me and what isn't? I'll do as I like, go where I will. Othello made it out unscathed, but I'm certain the experience frightened him. I ought to go see him as soon as possible.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Othello and I went to the woods together, and I showed him the castle... or at least, the fringes of it. And he taught me to swim. It was the kind of quiet, intimate night I've rarely shared with another person, let alone someone unrelated to me. One of those nights when you feel as if you've known someone forever after just a few hours. We were interrupted by Claudius. I've never been angrier in my life. How dare he try to tell me what's appropriate for me and what isn't? I'll do as I like, go where I will. Othello made it out unscathed, but I'm certain the experience frightened him. I ought to go see him as soon as possible.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I found Othello and apologized. He asked me to run away with him, to leave Elsinore forever and travel south. Quince promised me Othello was 'fated to love another,' but that we'd enjoy a good life together until that time came. Maybe that's enough.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The Prince's Ambitions

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet asked to meet me in private, and confided to me that he desires to 'prove his worth' to me and rekindle our relationship. First, though, he believes he must complete some 'dark work' of his own.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The 'dark work' to which Hamlet refers is avenging his father's murder. He cannot rest, or become King, until that mission is complete. There are ways I could assist him... were I so inclined.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet came to me after the news of his uncle's death was announced. He's done it. He's cleared all obstacles in his path to become King. But will he be able to successfully accomplish all it takes to be named the official heir? I can help him. I can ensure he has the right advice. The next few days shall be a critical window in which to act to determine the fate of the country as a whole, and of Hamlet's life.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I told Hamlet I wanted to try again, with us. That things might be different this time. I truly believe, in my heart of hearts, that he's changed... but will it stay that way? What if he returns to the horrid person he's been all summer? I'll have to abandon him again, then, and I'm not certain what would come of it. But for now, I remain hopeful.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet asked me to marry him. To become Queen. I'd never dared to think about it before now. But I consented. I'm going to rule. And when I do, I'm going to do what dozens of queens before me could not. I know the cost of death. I know what it is to suffer. Under me, no one will suffer as I have. Never again.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet lied to me. He told me he wanted to make me happy, to honor me... and now he's gone and banished Laertes and my father, believing them to be threats to his rule. Is this the cost of this world? Become Queen, but lose my family? What a rotten, horrid trick to play. Even so, they might be happier outside Elsinore. And far safer. Perhaps all is not lost.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: It appears to be the case that if I spurn Hamlet's advances, Queen Gertrude will ensure Brit and Hamlet are betrothed. What sort of world would it be, one where Lady Brit sits the throne? Perhaps it would behoove me to run this journey to its end and find out.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: ...And suddenly, my betrothal to Hamlet was formally announced. I think it came as quite the shock to everyone. This wedding is moving forward, at least in this world. Is this a world I would want to keep forever?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: A Journey At Sea

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Hamlet returned from his voyage to England, thanks to a bizarre scenario where pirates boarded his vessel and took him hostage. He believes there was a plot against his life right from the voyage's start. If I speak to the King about this, maybe I can uncover the truth of the matter.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I spoke to the King about the aforementioned plot against Hamlet's life. He seemed surprised and disturbed, but now believes me to be an ally of sorts. If I can only be there at the moment Hamlet steps aboard that ship, I might be able to find a way onto it myself.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I've made it aboard the ship. The King tasked me directly with ensuring Hamlet doesn't return to Denmark, and promised me a rich reward. I'm not certain I want any reward like that. For now, I'd like to merely observe and understand the situation.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白
